name: Pinterest
description: Visual discovery/social platform; API v5 covers pins, boards, ads, catalogs and analytics for organic and paid use cases.
access_notes: Free but review-gated in two tiers: submitting an app request grants Trial access after a (routine, business-day) review - Trial includes a sandbox (api-sandbox.pinterest.com), test tokens, 1,000 req/day cap and Pins hidden from the public. Production-grade Standard access requires a manual upgrade review including a video demo proving a compliant OAuth flow; rejections for missing OAuth demonstration are common. No paid tier.
mcp_notes: Composio has a PINTEREST_ADS toolkit (10 tools, OAuth2, not Composio-managed); no general-purpose Pinterest toolkit found in the catalog. No official Pinterest vendor MCP found on developers.pinterest.com.
uncertainty_notes: The only webhook-like mechanism found is the beta Lead Ads subscriptions endpoint (POST /ad_accounts/{id}/leads/subscriptions), which is 'not available to all apps'; there are no general-purpose webhooks in API v5, hence supports_webhooks=false.

evidence.note: App requests reviewed each business day for Trial access; requires building an OAuth 2 authorization-code flow with token refresh
Trial vs Standard access tiers; Standard upgrade requires a video recording demonstrating the OAuth flow, even for single-user apps
Self-serve sandbox environment (api-sandbox.pinterest.com) with sandbox tokens available at Trial or Standard tier
Composio toolkit catalog lists PINTEREST_ADS (10 tools, OAUTH2); no general Pinterest toolkit listed
